hooks.name: wiki-session-start
hooks.description: Load wiki schema and index on every session start

hooks.name: wiki-auto-lint-on-edit
hooks.description: Trigger lint reminder when wiki pages are edited
hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
echo '[Wiki Hook] Page edited. Consider running /lint if this was a significant update.'

hooks.name: wiki-index-reminder
hooks.description: Remind to update index when new pages are created
hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
echo '[Wiki Hook] New page created. Update wiki/index.md with new entry.'

hooks.name: wiki-log-stop
hooks.description: Log session end to wiki log

hooks.name: wiki-claim-validation
hooks.description: Validate claim pages have proper sourcing and last_reviewed after write
hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
# Parse file_path from Claude Code hook input JSON
FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
if [ -n "$FILE" ] && [ -f "$FILE" ]; then
  if ! grep -q 'source_evidence:' "$FILE"; then
    echo '[Wiki Hook] WARNING: Claim page missing source_evidence frontmatter' >&2
  fi
  if ! grep -q 'last_reviewed:' "$FILE"; then
    echo '[Wiki Hook] WARNING: Claim page missing last_reviewed frontmatter' >&2
  fi
else
  echo '[Wiki Hook] Could not determine file path for claim validation' >&2
fi

hooks.name: wiki-last-reviewed-reminder
hooks.description: Remind to bump last_reviewed when editing existing wiki pages
hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
TODAY=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
if [ -n "$FILE" ] && [ -f "$FILE" ]; then
  if grep -q 'last_reviewed:' "$FILE"; then
    CURRENT=$(grep -oP 'last_reviewed:\s*\K[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}' "$FILE" | head -1)
    if [ "$CURRENT" != "$TODAY" ] && [ -n "$CURRENT" ]; then
      echo "[Wiki Hook] last_reviewed is $CURRENT — consider bumping to $TODAY"
    fi
  fi
fi

hooks.name: wiki-security-scan
hooks.description: Prevent LLM from writing sensitive financial data to unencrypted locations
hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
# Parse file_path from Claude Code hook input JSON
FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
if [ -n "$FILE" ] && [ -f "$FILE" ]; then
  if grep -qE '(SSN|social.security|\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b)' "$FILE"; then
    echo '[Wiki Hook] CRITICAL: Potential PII detected in wiki page' >&2
    exit 1
  fi
else
  echo '[Wiki Hook] Could not determine file path for security scan' >&2
fi

hooks.name: wiki-evidence-locator-check
hooks.description: Warn when a supported claim lacks exact evidence locators
hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
if [ -n "$FILE" ] && [ -f "$FILE" ]; then
  if grep -q 'status: supported' "$FILE" && ! grep -qE '\[S-[a-fA-F0-9]{16},' "$FILE"; then
    echo '[Wiki Hook] WARNING: Supported claim lacks exact evidence locator [S-<id>, p. N]' >&2
  fi
fi

hooks.name: wiki-investigation-integrity
hooks.description: Warn when an investigation page is missing required sections
hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
if [ -n "$FILE" ] && [ -f "$FILE" ]; then
  REQUIRED=("Decision question" "Scope and definitions" "Current thesis" "Supporting evidence" "Counterevidence" "Unknowns" "Invalidation conditions" "Implications" "Change history")
  MISSING=""
  for section in "${REQUIRED[@]}"; do
    if ! grep -q "^## $section$" "$FILE"; then
      MISSING="$MISSING $section"
    fi
  done
  if [ -n "$MISSING" ]; then
    echo "[Wiki Hook] WARNING: Investigation missing required sections:$MISSING" >&2
  fi
fi

hooks.name: wiki-post-ingest-verification
hooks.description: Run orphan and cross-reference check after source page writes
hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
VAULT=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR
SOURCE_FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
echo "[Wiki Hook] Source page written. Quick verification:"
echo "  - Orphan claims: $(for c in $VAULT/wiki/claims/*.md; do grep -l "$(basename "$SOURCE_FILE" .md)" "$c" 2>/dev/null; done | wc -l | tr -d ' ') claim(s) reference this source"
echo "  - Total wiki pages: $(find $VAULT/wiki -name '*.md' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
echo "  - Run /lint for full cross-reference integrity check."

hooks.name: wiki-qmd-refresh-reminder
hooks.description: Remind to re-index qmd after 3+ wiki writes since last refresh
hooks.matcher: (tool == 'Write' || tool == 'Edit') && (tool_input.file_path matches 'wiki/.*\.md$' || tool_input.file_path matches 'config/purpose\.md$' || tool_input.file_path matches 'config/materiality\.md$' || tool_input.file_path matches 'config/retrieval\.md$' || tool_input.file_path matches 'CLAUDE\.md$')
hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
VAULT=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR

# Ensure timestamp file exists
if [ ! -f "$VAULT/.qmd-last-refresh" ]; then
  touch "$VAULT/.qmd-last-refresh"
fi

# Count wiki pages changed since last qmd refresh
COUNT=$(find "$VAULT/wiki" "$VAULT/config" -name '*.md' -newer "$VAULT/.qmd-last-refresh" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')

if [ "$COUNT" -gt 3 ] 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "[Wiki Hook] $COUNT pages modified since last qmd refresh. Run: qmd update && qmd embed && touch .qmd-last-refresh"
fi
